# RealTTS

> RealTTS is two-way real-time interpretation software that translates live voice on WeChat, WhatsApp, LINE, Zoom, Telegram and more. Your clients install nothing. Never lose an order to a language barrier again.

Two-way speech recognition, translation and natural voice output in real time. You focus on deals, products and relationships. RealTTS handles language.

RealTTS works through a virtual audio device. As long as your chat or calling app lets you pick the microphone or speaker — WeChat, WhatsApp, LINE, Zoom, Teams, Skype and more — real-time two-way translation just works, with zero installation on the client side.

Response time is in seconds and two-way translation is almost simultaneous, so the conversation flows naturally and your client never feels they are waiting for a translation.

## Supported languages

- Translates 13 business languages, covering the major global trade markets, with more being added.
- Interface available in 9 languages: 简体中文, 繁體中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Español, Português, العربية.

## Platform and compatibility

- Runs on Windows 10+, macOS, and on mobile for two-way live conversation anywhere.
- WeChat · WhatsApp · LINE · Zoom · Teams · Skype — if it lets you choose audio devices, it works seamlessly.

## Pricing

Billed monthly per device, upgrade anytime. Price includes live two-way translation, export and support.

- **Monthly**: $20 / month / device
- **Quarterly**: $57 / quarter / device
- **Annual**: $230 / year / device
- Every base plan includes 1 multi-person meeting room. If several salespeople need their own rooms at the same time, tell us when you buy: each extra room is $5 / month / room.

## Try RealTTS for Free

- Experience real-time two-way voice translation at no cost. Add us on WeChat to claim your free trial — works with WeChat, WhatsApp and LINE.
